text: My daughter is 4 months old and she's had a temperature this evening, it was 38.4 when I took it about half an hour ago. We've been giving her infant paracetamol as the leaflet says and honestly between doses she seems fine, she's kicking about on her mat playing, she's taken her bottle no problem and she's cooing and chatting away at us like normal. But she's so tiny and I keep reading that babies under 6 months with a fever are different and I've worked myself into a state. My wife's asleep and I didn't want to wake her if it's nothing. I just need someone to tell me whether this is something we can watch at home or whether I should be taking her somewhere right now. Sorry it's a long message, I'm just scared of missing something.
